What was the exact problem here?  Spaces are currently replaced with underscores.

The Name property is generally separated by spaces. However, if a variable is used (in this case, $bus), spaces are not allowed; otherwise, D-Bus will not display it correctly. Additionally, underscores cannot be used in the Name property either, as they will also cause display issues in D-Bus.

Can you elaborate on "dbus will not display it correctly"?  What is the expected and observed behavior?  Just saying "will not display correctly" isn't helpful for people trying to get on the same page as you.

Taking FAN as an example, the expected name is "FAN0_TACH_IL_SPEED_RPM".

Previously, the name attribute in the JSON was set using the expression:
"FAN$bus - 1 % 2 * 4 + 0_TACH_IL".
With this configuration, we observed that the sensor name only appeared as "FAN0", and the full expected name was not displayed properly.

After changing the configuration to:
"FAN$bus - 1 % 2 * 4 + 0 TACH_IL" (removing the underscore _),
the full name was displayed correctly as expected.

Before modification (using "FAN$bus - 1 % 2 * 4 + 0_TACH_IL"):
├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN0  <== Incorrect name shown
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN0_TACH_OL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN1_TACH_IL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN1_TACH_OL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN2_TACH_IL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN2_TACH_OL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN3_TACH_IL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN3_TACH_OL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/NVIDIA_GB300_CPU0

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
After modification (using "FAN$bus - 1 % 2 * 4 + 0 TACH_IL"):
├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN0_TACH_IL_SPEED_RPM  <== Correct name shown
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN0_TACH_OL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN1_TACH_IL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN1_TACH_OL_SPEED_RPM
│ ├─ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/NVIDIA_GB300_0/FAN2_TACH_IL_SPEED_RPM
